expression: (async () => { const pause=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const buttons=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('button')]; const sidebarToggle=buttons().find(el=>/Показать боковую панель/i.test(el.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')); if(sidebarToggle){sidebarToggle.click(); await pause(350);} const board=()=>buttons().find(el=>el.textContent?.trim()==='Board'); const open=async(name)=>{board()?.click(); await pause(350); const card=buttons().find(el=>el.getAttribute('title')===name); if(!card) throw new Error('missing card '+name); card.click(); await pause(500); const expand=buttons().find(el=>/Развернуть проект|Expand project/i.test(el.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')); if(!expand) throw new Error('missing expand for '+name); expand.click(); await pause(500);}; for(const name of ['Archive 01','Active 01','Atlas Website']) await open(name); return {tabs:buttons().filter(el=>['Workspace App','Archive 01','Active 01','Atlas Website'].includes(el.getAttribute('title')||'')).map(el=>({title:el.getAttribute('title'),text:el.textContent?.trim()})),active:document.querySelector('.workspace-project-detail-heading')?.textContent?.trim()}; })()
